exposure: Employment status 6 months prior to delivery
outcome: Breastfeeding rates at discharge from hospital and 3 months postpartum
finding: While breastfeeding initiation rates were high (98.1%), only 36.5% of mothers were fully breastfeeding at hospital discharge, with nationality, employment status, mode of delivery, sex of the child, and breastfeeding information from nurses being significantly associated with breastfeeding duration.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with breastfeeding duration (P=0.01).
